name: Geometry
description: 2D affine Matrix, the Transform (position, scale, rotation; scene space is y down) layers and instances use, axis-aligned Rect, vector Paths with line, quadratic and cubic segments and their affine transform, tight shape bounds, and point hit testing (even-odd and nonzero fill, strokes, through instances). The per-frame render list of a scene or symbol: one walk that gives the layer and instance tree exporters write and the flat paint-order items (matrix, multiplied opacity, inherited lock, address) the stage draws; the queries over it (topmost hit with a tolerance, marquee, world bounds with stroke); and the path builders for rectangles, ellipses, polygons and stars. Nothing here traps on non-finite input.
